description: Standalone responsive inspector panel. Auto docks in-flow when its container resolves Desktop and composes a modal TmDrawer on narrower ones — the sheet position follows the VIEWPORT (right/left side sheet on a tablet or desktop viewport, bottom sheet on a mobile viewport); Docked and Sheet pin the choice at every width. For editors with a dedicated frame see TmEditorShell.

parameters.name: Presentation
parameters.description: How the panel presents itself: Auto docks when the container resolves Desktop and is a sheet otherwise; Docked and Sheet pin the choice.

parameters.name: Open
parameters.description: Whether the panel is open. Two-way with OpenChanged.

parameters.name: OpenChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the panel should open or close (every close path funnels through here).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Title shown in the panel header; also the accessible name of the sheet.

parameters.name: CloseOnEscape
parameters.description: When true, Escape closes the DOCKED panel through OpenChanged. Default false: a docked panel is in-flow and leaves Escape to the host. The sheet presentation already closes on Escape and ignores this.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: Id of the host element (typically the opener button) focus returns to when the SHEET presentation closes — via Escape, the header close, the backdrop, a swipe or the host setting Open to false. Null keeps the focus scope default.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Optional actions rendered in the header, next to the close button.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: The host's own chrome carries the title/close (e.g. a panel that renders its own header): opt out of the built-in header row. When false the sheet renders no header and no drawer close button (the host content owns its own), and the panel falls back to the localized default accessible name.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Main body content.

parameters.name: FooterContent
parameters.description: Optional footer below the body (apply / cancel actions), sticky at the bottom of the docked panel and of the sheet.

parameters.name: Side
parameters.description: The edge the panel belongs to (Right inspector, Left navigation/task panel); decides the edge the side sheet slides in from.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the docked panel and of the side sheet. Ignored by the bottom sheet, which sizes from its snap point.

parameters.name: SheetHeight
parameters.description: How tall the BOTTOM sheet is on a phone layout: Snap rests on SheetSnapPoints (half height out of the box); Content makes the sheet as tall as its content under SheetMaxHeight - a short form is shown whole without dragging, a longer body scrolls and the FooterContent stays pinned to the bottom. The docked panel and the side sheet ignore it.

parameters.name: SheetSnapPoints
parameters.description: Fractions of the viewport height the bottom sheet snaps to, ascending, each between 0 and 1 (for example [0.7, 1.0] opens a form at 70 %). Null keeps the drawer default, half height and the cap. A value above SheetMaxHeight is clamped to it. Ignored with SheetHeight = Content, by the docked panel and by the side sheet.

parameters.name: SheetSnapIndex
parameters.description: The snap (an index into SheetSnapPoints) the bottom sheet renders. Two-way with SheetSnapIndexChanged: the sheet adopts a changed value and reports the snap a drag or the handle's keyboard settled on.

parameters.name: SheetSnapIndexChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the bottom sheet settles on another snap (a drag, the handle's arrow keys, Home / End).

parameters.name: SheetMaxHeight
parameters.description: The tallest fraction of the viewport the bottom sheet may cover, between 0 and 1: the cap of the snaps and of the content height. Null keeps the drawer default of 0.85, which leaves a sliver of the page behind the sheet visible.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the presentation resolves from. Auto follows the nearest unnamed layout context; a forced value renders that mode without a DOM.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement. Desktop unless the host says otherwise.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes. The initial value is not a change. Never pair LayoutMode with this callback: it reports the resolved mode, and a two-way bind would pin that mode.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes for the root (the docked root, or the sheet root through TmDrawer.Class).
